source_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus a NUL separator, file bytes and a trailing NUL separator for each path, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

implementation.ipc: popout:open validates a selected vault identity and safe relative Markdown path; popout:intent delivers the path to a child BrowserWindow using the same context-isolated, sandboxed preload.
implementation.lifecycle: The main process reuses a child by vault-root and relative path, tracks its WebContents sender, closes tracked children on vault changes and rejects nested or stale-vault child access.
implementation.editor: The popout page is intentionally limited to readFile/writeFile plus the typed intent listener. It displays the path, revision-aware save status, reload action, accessible editor label and Meta/Ctrl-S save shortcut.
implementation.safety: Popout writes pass the existing VaultStore revision check. A conflict preserves incoming bytes in recovery storage, keeps the unsaved editor value visible and offers an explicit reload action; no save occurs during input alone.
